as_told.title: Gifted programs as a funnel into psi programs

plain: Michels says that school programmes for gifted and talented children seem to have acted as a funnel for recruiting young people into deeper, secret programmes that study psychic ability. He offers it partly as his own reading, and partly credits it to Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot who says he retrieved a UFO, who went public about the gifted and talented programmes, and to two people named Jordan Jose and Julia Mosbury. If true, it would mean children were being picked out for this work through ordinary schools.
